verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is built for exactly this: you drop in a reference video or paste a link, it analyzes shot count, lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves, then plans and generates new footage, showing style frames for approval first. Style fidelity is bounded by seven 2D drawing engines, and references that match no known style fall back to the closest engine plus a proposal for a new style. Missing for 10: explicit support for a still image as the style reference, faithful mimicry beyond the seven 2D engines (no 3D or live-action), and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
